buildingExclusions.sourceText: building=university; disused=yes; name=Memorial Hall; note=closed following post-earthquake damage and assessment
buildingExclusions.reason: OpenStreetMap maps it as disused (disused=yes): a building that is not in use. The surroundings draw it as they draw any other building, unless it overlaps one of Lincoln University's buildings on the map or covers less than 12 square metres. Its note tag, kept in this record, says why.

buildingExclusions.reason: Its name, AgResearch, is the name of another body, not Lincoln University's: building=university alone does not make a building the University's when its name says whose it is. The surroundings draw it as they draw any other building, unless it overlaps one of Lincoln University's buildings on the map or covers less than 12 square metres. Its description tag, kept in this record, says what it is.
